name: Supabase
description: Supabase is a hosted application platform for Postgres, Auth, Storage, Functions, Realtime, and project infrastructure.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Supabase Organization and selected Project through Relay's published confidential OAuth App with S256 PKCE and only app-configured organizations:read and projects:read, then inspect the Organization, its bounded offset-zero Project page, and the selected Project. Relay V1 excludes database details and data, keys, secrets, config, user/product data, writes, administration, PATs, raw APIs, and pagination.

blocked.label: Use raw Supabase API
